title: INCOLOR SSR Build | The Weight Surprised Us

takeaways.text: Measure the integrated seat mast and steerer carefully before cutting; the supplied Incolor saddle has limited fore-aft rail adjustment, so they swapped it.

The front brake hose enters a small port in the bayonet steerer and the rear hose exits a rear port into the frame; the stiff guide cable supplied in Incolor's kit worked better than flimsy magnetic routing tools. Rear hose routing still took effort.
The T47A asymmetric bottom bracket changes crank spacer calculations: their crank needed 2.5 mm on the non-drive side and none on the drive side, contrary to the crank maker's instructions.
The finished size-54 full Dura-Ace build with 8lien wheels and lightweight parts weighed 6.31 kg; Incolor's own thru-axles weighed 43 g versus 28 g for aftermarket ones.

disclosure: Underdogs Cycling is a parts retailer that promotes components it sells in this build; the SSR came from Incolor's pre-order package.
summary: Retailer workshop build of a size-54 Incolor SSR with Dura-Ace and lightweight aftermarket parts, including a final weigh-in.
